summary: Idaho Power Co. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $200 million qualified reopening of its 5.70% First Mortgage Bonds due 2055, adding to $400 million issued March 2025, bringing total to $600 million. Price to public was 94.186% of par, with underwriters led by J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, MUFG, Wells Fargo, BofA, Morgan Stanley, and US Bancorp. This is a routine debt takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; the offering is a conventional capital markets transaction with no change of control, strategic event, or restructuring implications. What to watch is ordinary secondary-market performance of the consolidated issue.
